summary: Verified iter 54 features: (1) NEW AdminAccountRepair panel (account-repair-tool) renders under existing AdminStorefrontRepair on /admin Approvals tab; (2) searching 'brokendriver' returns a row showing 'Needs repair' with issue 'Driver is approved but the account role was never promoted — no Driver panel.'; (3) clicking Repair transitions the row to 'Healthy' with role 'Driver (Active)' and calls POST /api/admin/accounts/repair (verified via UI + curl in pytest); (4) repaired driver can log in and reach /driver-dashboard with driver-* data-testids (previously blocked); (5) POST /orders/{id}/accept-driver JSON body model no longer rejects the frontend-shaped body — no 422 on valid shape, 404 on unknown order. Storefront-repair regression: storefront-repair-tool + storefront-repair-input still render and are functional.

critical_code_review_comments: server.py account repair endpoints are clean, idempotent, and properly gate on user_type=='admin' (POST) / admin+agent (GET). Good use of Pydantic AccountRepairRequest body.
AdminAccountRepair.js uses localStorage 'token' Bearer header — matches admin panel convention (cookie also present as fallback).
Route promotion via promote_user_role() and driver_wallet creation are both guarded (idempotent) — safe to click Repair multiple times.
Frontend AdminAccountRepair re-runs search() after repair so the row auto-refreshes to Healthy — good UX.
